name: gizza-ai/scatter-chart
summary: Render a scatter plot as an SVG chart.

tool.description: Render a scatter plot from x/y data as an SVG chart (axes with min/mid/max tick labels and gridlines, one circle per point). Points are a JSON array of [x, y] pairs or {x, y, category, size} objects: category colours points and adds a legend; size scales the marker radius. Optional title, width, height. Returns an SVG image.

data.description: Points as a JSON array. Each point is either [x, y] or an object {"x":..,"y":..,"category":"..","size":..}. category colours the point (with a legend); size scales the marker. E.g. [[1,2],[3,4]] or [{"x":1,"y":2,"category":"A"}].
